points.description: Run-of-river plant (accept run-off river / run of river type)
Storage plant (accept reservoir plant / storage type)
Cascade plant (series of plants on the same river, one using the outflow of another)
Pumped storage plant (accept pumped-storage / pump-back plant)

rubric.notes: Each of the four types is worth 0.5 marks; clear synonyms are accepted (e.g. reservoir plant for storage plant). Total is rounded to a whole mark by the teacher's 0/1/2 scale: all four or three correct items give 2, two items give 1, one or none gives 0 (round 1.5 up to 2). Wrong extra types, or classifications not based on hydraulic characteristics (e.g. by head or capacity), earn nothing and do not cancel correct items.
